description: A hybrid fund that dynamically allocates between equity and debt based on market valuations, aiming for balanced growth with lower volatility than pure equity funds.
Invests primarily in large, well-established companies with strong market capitalization, targeting long-term capital appreciation.
An equity-linked savings scheme offering tax deductions under Section 80C, with a 3-year lock-in period, investing across market capitalizations.
A low-duration debt fund investing in short-term money market instruments, suited for conservative investors seeking stability over growth.
